item.title: Power Problems Are Killing Your Gadgets: How to Protect a Tech-Heavy Home
item.summary: The average Australian household now runs on a small data centre’s worth of electronics: mesh Wi-Fi nodes, NAS drives, gaming rigs, OLED panels, smart hubs, security cameras and a growing fleet of lithium battery chargers. What most of those households have never upgraded is the thing all of it plugs into.
